prose: Basis: the Financial Times blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Meta is planning to raise $95 billion to finance its AI infrastructure, including $35 billion in public equity offerings, with chipmakers Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom acting as cornerstone investors. The structure is striking: the companies selling Meta the chips are also underwriting the raise that pays for them.
highlights: Meta plans a $95B raise to finance AI infrastructure
$35B would come via public equity offerings
Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom act as cornerstone investors - chip suppliers underwriting the buyer
